sense.text:
Opened on the new moon, a feast day, for those that are weak in faith: these scriptures are for you.

“But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation.” That is the key point, and when you get to the key point you have to slow down: “from the beginning.” God chose you to salvation from the beginning.
